Quest name: A unicorn's horn (Chrono Quest - 3rd period, 18th Century)
Quest location: St. Petersburg Adventurers' Guild
Skill requirement: r7 Ecological Research, r9 Biology, ARC(Far North Languages)
Pre-requisite discovery: Bering Strait discovery (from "Investigation: the eastern ridge of the northeastern passage" quest) + Upright Hypericum discovery (from "Essence of Ointment" quest)
Pre-requisite action (hidden): 1st Eastern Region of Eurasia (Far East of Eurasia) permit obtained
